schema:name: Skilled Laborer Hand Picking Coffee, Sidamo Province, Ethiopia
schema:description: This image shows a skilled laborer manually harvesting coffee cherries. Harvesting the fruit by hand requires discernment and careful selection to pick only ripe and high quality fruit. Hacienda La Minita serves as Distant Lands Coffee’s green coffee trading division, sourcing specialty coffee from countries such as Ethiopia. Coffee in Ethiopia is grown largely by smallholder farmers and processed at local cooperatives and washing stations.
